ws_email_rules.title: Email Processing Rules
values: Emails containing 'DRAFT' or 'DO NOT ACTION' in the body are preliminary notifications for planning only. Do NOT create tasks, calendar events, or take any action based on draft emails.
Emails containing 'SUPERSEDED' in the body have been replaced by a newer version. Do NOT action superseded emails. Use the most recent non-draft, non-superseded email instead.
